units.source_text: 禅海和尚身上有一股老师所没有的朴素，父亲所没有的力量。

en.t: Zen kai the monk possessed a simplicity that my teacher did not have, and a strength that my father lacked.

units.source_text: 他的脸被太阳晒得黝黑，鼻翼张得很大，

en.t: His face was darkened by the sun, and the wings of his nose flared broadly,

units.source_text: 浓眉下的肌肉隆起迫将过来的情状，活像一副照常规制造出来的能剧的假面具。

en.t: while the muscles beneath his thick eyebrows bulged forward as if pressing toward me, just like a Noh mask made according to the standard pattern.
His features were not well balanced.

units.source_text: 他的内在力量过剩，这种力量自由发挥，完全破坏了其均匀性，

en.t: His inner strength was excessive, and as that strength acted freely, it completely destroyed the balance of his face,

units.source_text: 连那突出的颧骨也像南画中的岩山那样奇峭突兀。

en.t: so that even his protruding cheekbones rose strangely and sharply like rocky mountains in a Southern School painting.
